open_points.subject: OWNED CLASSES REQUIRED / MODULE-LOCAL EXCEPTION EXPORTS
open_points.text:
OWNED CLASSES REQUIRED (must be defined locally, not merely referenced):
No owned local classes required.
open_points.other_text:
MODULE-LOCAL EXCEPTION EXPORTS:
If any exception class is listed here, define it in this file at top level.
Do not import these classes from core.errors or any other module.
- class IdentityInputRejected(Exception): pass
open_points.question: Must IdentityInputRejected be defined locally, or must the statement that no owned local classes are required change?

open_points.subject: authenticate_staff / change_staff_status
open_points.text: - authenticate_staff: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST normalize email, accept only an account whose status is StaffStatus.ACTIVE with a matching password, deciding nothing on email_verified_at, issue a hashed fixed-expiry session, audit success or concealed failure, and never reveal which check failed.
open_points.other_text: A transition into active from pending_verification MUST also record email_verified_at at that same captured timestamp: while the self-service verification challenge has no storage, the administrator performing the activation is what vouches for the address, and an account left unverified could never authenticate.
open_points.question: Does authentication ignore email_verified_at, or is an active account with no email_verified_at unable to authenticate?

open_points.subject: resolve_staff_session / change_staff_status
open_points.text: - resolve_staff_session: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST parse the R17 selector, verify its secret hash, fixed expiry, revocation and that the account status is StaffStatus.ACTIVE before returning StaffActorContext, deciding nothing on email_verified_at; any failure raises AuthenticationRejected.
open_points.other_text: A transition into active from pending_verification MUST also record email_verified_at at that same captured timestamp: while the self-service verification challenge has no storage, the administrator performing the activation is what vouches for the address, and an account left unverified could never authenticate.
open_points.question: Does session resolution ignore email_verified_at, or must an active account without email_verified_at be rejected as unable to authenticate?
